hopes faded: As the days passed without any news from the missing climbers, hopes faded among their worried families.
隨著日子一天天過去，失蹤登山客仍音訊全無，他們焦急的家人希望漸失。
fade from memory: Even though the trip was ten years ago, it will never fade from memory because it was so special.
雖然那趟旅行是十年前的事了，但它永遠不會從記憶中淡去，因為它太特別了。
fade into the background: After retiring, the famous singer chose to fade into the background, slowly appearing less and less on TV.
退休後，那位知名歌手選擇淡出，在電視上露面的次數逐漸減少。
colors fade: If you hang your clothes in strong sunlight for too long, the colors fade and they look old.
如果你把衣服掛在強烈的陽光下太久，就會褪色，看起來很舊。
fade away: The sound of the train slowly began to fade away as it disappeared into the dark mountains.
火車消失在漆黑的山中，它的聲音也慢慢地逐漸消失。
fail an exam: If you don't start studying now, you might fail an exam and have to take the course again.
如果你現在不開始讀書，你可能會考試不及格，必須重修這門課。
fail to notice: Many drivers fail to notice cyclists coming from behind when they open their car doors.
許多駕駛在開車門時，未注意到從後方騎來的自行車騎士。
words fail me: Thank you all for this wonderful surprise party; I am so touched that words fail me right now.
謝謝大家為我辦這場美好的驚喜派對；我感動到此刻說不出話來。
the crops failed: Because there was no rain all summer, the crops failed and many farmers had nothing to sell.
由於整個夏天都沒下雨，作物歉收，許多農夫沒有東西可以賣。
fail a student: The professor said he would fail a student who copied answers from the Internet.
教授說他會當掉從網路上抄答案的學生。
the brakes failed: The bus driver stayed calm when the brakes failed on the steep mountain road.
當公車在陡峭的山路上煞車失靈時，司機保持冷靜。
faint from hunger: The hikers had not eaten for two days and were about to faint from hunger when rescuers found them.
登山客已經兩天沒吃東西，救難人員找到他們時，他們幾乎快要餓昏了。
a faint hope: Although the doctors were not optimistic, the family still held on to a faint hope that he would wake up.
雖然醫生並不樂觀，家人仍抱著一線希望，盼他能醒過來。
faint praise: The coach gave only faint praise to the team, saying their performance was 'not too bad'.
教練只給了球隊不痛不癢的稱讚，說他們的表現「還不算太差」。
feel faint: If you stand in the hot sun for hours without drinking water, you may feel faint and need to sit down.
如果你在大太陽下站好幾個小時不喝水，你可能會頭暈而需要坐下來。
fake an illness: He tried to fake an illness so he could stay home from school, but his mother saw through it.
他想裝病好待在家不去上學，但他媽媽一眼就看穿了。
fake a signature: The boy tried to fake a signature on his report card because he was afraid to show his parents his grades.
那男孩想在成績單上偽造簽名，因為他不敢讓父母看他的成績。
fake surprise: She already knew about the party, but she had to fake surprise when everyone shouted 'Happy birthday!'
她早就知道派對的事，但當大家大喊「生日快樂！」時，她得假裝驚訝。
fake it till you make it: When you start a new job and feel nervous, sometimes you just have to fake it till you make it.
當你開始新工作感到緊張時，有時候你只能假裝直到成真。
fancy a drink: It's been a long day at the office; do you fancy a drink at the café around the corner?
今天在辦公室忙了一整天，你想不想去轉角的咖啡廳喝一杯？
fancy oneself as: My brother fancies himself as a great cook, but most of his dishes are too salty to eat.
我哥哥自以為是個大廚，但他煮的菜大多鹹得難以入口。
fancy that!: "Our teacher used to be a rock star when she was young." "Well, fancy that! I never would have guessed."
「我們老師年輕時曾是搖滾歌手。」「哇，真想不到！我從沒猜到過。」
take a fancy to: The little girl seemed to take a fancy to the puppy and refused to leave the pet shop without it.
小女孩似乎喜歡上了那隻小狗，不帶牠走就不肯離開寵物店。
be fascinated by: Ever since he was little, he has been fascinated by the stars and spends hours looking at them through a telescope.
他從小就為星星著迷，常花好幾個小時用望遠鏡觀察它們。
fascinate the audience: The magician's amazing tricks never fail to fascinate the audience, both children and adults.
那位魔術師的驚人把戲總能令觀眾著迷，無論是小孩還是大人。
a fascinating story: Grandpa told us a fascinating story about sailing around the world, and we listened without moving for an hour.
爺爺給我們講了一個環遊世界航海的引人入勝的故事，我們一動也不動地聽了一個小時。
fashion a tool from wood: Lost in the forest, the survivor had to fashion a tool from wood to dig for water.
在森林中迷路的倖存者，必須用木頭做工具來挖水。
fashion a solution: The two sides talked all night and finally managed to fashion a solution that satisfied everyone.
雙方談了一整夜，終於想出了一個讓大家都滿意的解決之道。
after a fashion: I can speak Japanese after a fashion, but I still can't understand the news on TV.
我勉強算是會說日文，但還是聽不懂電視上的新聞。
